Company Profile

Who We Are

Established in Nairobi, Kenya, in 2012, Ammiton Investments has grown from a stationery retail point into a diversified supplier of office, technology and institutional solutions.

Today we serve schools, corporate organisations and government bodies with uniforms, workwear, security wear, stationery, ICT equipment, furniture and general supplies.

Our Mission

To deliver increasing value and quality through:

  • Solutions tailored to customers’ specific needs
  • High-quality products at competitive prices
  • Unparalleled execution in all interactions

Clients We Serve

  • Credit Bank
  • Hospital Hill High School
  • East African Building Society
  • Kenya Seed Company Limited
  • National Youth Service – NYS Thika
